title: Rectangle Properties
description:
Read the length and width of a rectangle from input. Print its area, perimeter, and diagonal (rounded to 2 decimal places). The diagonal of a rectangle is `sqrt(length² + width²)`.

**Example (inputs: `6`, `8`):**
```
Area: 48
Perimeter: 28
Diagonal: 10.0
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
length = float(input())
width = float(input())
